name: ComingUp
requirements: Free daily launch board ranked by votes — no paid tier anywhere.
Account required: email + password (≥8 chars with upper, lower, number, special char) verified by a 6-digit code, or SideProjectors OAuth.
Rate limit: one product per account per day.
Vote counts are revealed at 12:00 UTC; voting itself requires an account at least 24 hours old.
preparation: The 8-field form (~6 required): product name, tagline/description, URL, category, tags, and images — images effectively required since all listed products carry one.
A chosen launch date — you can pick today or later.
A voting plan: top-of-day typically takes ~12–16 votes.
workflow: Register at comingup.io (email + password, then the 6-digit verification code) or sign in via SideProjectors.
Pick the launch date and submit — product sits in that day's ranking ordered by votes.
Rally voters (note the 24h account-age requirement for voters).
watchFor: The /submit page returns only shell to a plain fetch — the form requires an authenticated browser session.
Outbound link is reported nofollow (~97% of listings) — value is the launch-day exposure, not SEO.
Domain DR is ~0 per third-party measurement — zero link authority; this is a community board.
One product per account per day; voter accounts must be ≥24h old — plan voting brigade lead time.
countsAsLive: The product appears on the ComingUp homepage under the chosen day's 'Top Products Launching' list and gets a public /p/<slug> page.
unknowns: Exact required vs optional form fields (third-party says 8 fields, ~6 required).
Whether listings persist permanently or only per-day.
